name: ak-trivy-verify-fixture
comment: lodash 4.17.15 carries CVE-2021-23337 (HIGH, command injection via template)
and CVE-2020-8203 (HIGH, prototype pollution), both fixed in 4.17.21.
These are long-settled, universally-carried advisories, so this fixture
keeps producing findings across vulnerability-DB revisions.
DO NOT bump these versions: a build that scans this tree and reports
nothing is a broken scanner, and that is exactly what we are testing for.
